changelog:
v1.2.0 introduces dual output formatting, enhanced troubleshooting, and key fixes:

- Added dual-format output: IMA Markdown (with `#` title) for saving, QQ plain text for push-only (not saved).
- Introduced a troubleshooting section with 7 common issues and solutions.
- Added documentation for critical configuration parameters and real-world experience links.
- Fixed scheduled task timeout (increased from 300s to 600s) and updated execution time to 16:00.
- Updated templates and output rules for clearer, more structured reports.
